dogecoin.text: JUST IN: Elon Musk says that the U.S. government has no plans to use Dogecoin, despite the similarity in names with the Department of Government Efficiency (D.O.G.E.). https://t.co/XHFAx09mdr
JUST IN: A Dogecoin developer cautions that anyone promoting tokens, rather than true coins like Dogecoin or Bitcoin, should be seen as part of a scam.
JUST IN: The SEC has postponed decisions on Bitwise's Dogecoin ETF and Franklin Templeton's XRP ETF to June 15 and June 17, 2025, respectively.
JUST IN: Nasdaq has filed a 19b-4 form with the SEC for a new 21Shares Spot Dogecoin ETF. https://t.co/03Vsrypu8o
JUST IN: The SEC delays its review of spot crypto ETF filings by 21Shares and Grayscale, including Grayscale’s proposed Dogecoin ETF.
